notablePrerequisites:
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Your have at least four devotion to any color.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Nyx Lotus and Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.
